title: GuvFX Market Data Source v1
description: Identity and governance classification of a governed GuvFX market-data source (producer side). Carries NO login, account number, password, token or server credential. GuvFX is the producer; TIM is a read-only consumer (GFX-ADR-TIM-001). Synthetic/design contract under GFX-PKT-TIM-C1.

source_type.description: Source terminal class. The pilot uses a non-production demo/research source only.

server_identity.description: Broker server label (an identifier only, never a credential).

account_type.description: Non-production research tier; never a live-execution account. No account number is carried.

source_timezone.description: IANA timezone name of the source (e.g. 'Etc/UTC', 'Europe/Athens'). Canonical records normalise to UTC.

licensing_classification.description: Licensing class. No credentials or secrets are embedded; a missing/unlicensed classification fails closed.

licensing_reference.description: Pointer to the written licensing-approval record; null when not yet approved (source then quarantines).
